assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are not publicly available in the repository.
assumptions.impact: All submitted geometry uses repository provisional constraints and must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_or_confirmation_trigger: Replace site_boundary/key_areas, regenerate all design layers, metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs, and manifest hashes.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, building coverage, green ratio, setbacks, and road redlines are missing.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development intensity is claimed; design geometry is a spatial hypothesis only.
assumptions.recalculation_or_confirmation_trigger: Professional team confirms current regulatory detailed planning conditions.

assumptions.statement: Cleared parcel, ownership, existing-building, heritage-control, municipal, fire, and public-facility surveys are missing.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolish/retain conclusion or engineering alignment is made.
assumptions.recalculation_or_confirmation_trigger: Complete site survey and stakeholder verification before any implementation decision.

assumptions.statement: The proposed response-time targets are service-design hypotheses, not legal deadlines or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Targets require pilot measurement, staffing tests, accessibility review, and public consultation.
assumptions.recalculation_or_confirmation_trigger: Revise targets using observed demand, staffing capacity, and applicable service rules.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are background references with different institutions, laws, markets, and urban forms.
assumptions.impact: Only mechanisms are transferred; no direct performance equivalence is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_or_confirmation_trigger: Local professional and community review determines suitability.
